_about: Mirror of Tennis101 HQ (https://claude.ai/artifact/T2eXNa7ibx52NiDNAo9GoF), written by Claude when it syncs HQ (tools/command-center/SYNC.md). The CEO's orders override supervisors'. Don't edit by hand: change it in HQ.

motion-body.name: Motion & Body
motion-body.mission: How every body and racket moves: captured serves, joints, frames, racket paths, anatomy.
motion-body.brief:
Shared facts for every member:
• Serve motions: SERVE_MOTIONS[id] = {first, second}, joints in body heights, seen from behind (src/serve/motion/).
• Sinner's 1st serve comes from the slow-motion back-side clip; Alcaraz's 1st from his Indian Wells clip; his 2nd is still hand-keyed.
• Arms are drawn in depth order: a hand in front of a body seen from behind is hidden by the torso.
• Return stance: Anim kind “receive” (low, wide, bent forward).
• Anatomy data: datasets/anatomy/ (US Open Alcaraz vs Shelton pose).

look-world.name: Look & World
look-world.mission: What the game looks like: players, outfits, signature looks, courts, and the footage behind them.
look-world.brief:
Shared facts for every member:
• Signature looks are exaggerated on purpose: Sinner = oversized cap + ginger curls; Alcaraz = long hair, white hairband, beard.
• Outfits per court: grass (Wimbledon), hard (US Open), clay (Roland-Garros); hex colours in datasets/players/<id>/appearance.json.
• Video and photos never leave Ryan's Mac; new media arrives through the Tennis101 Inbox app (datasets/inbox).
• No brand logos or trademarked kit designs.

gameplay.name: Gameplay & Physics
gameplay.mission: How the game plays: ball physics, serving, controls, skills and cameras. Each agent keeps its own part.
gameplay.brief:
Each agent owns one part; agree on the contracts in agents/README.md before changing a shared one.
• Skill points: one point = one constant step (src/skills/skills.js).
• Slice: about half a drive's speed, low bounce.
• Controls: WASD moves, arrows/click aim, E slice, Space slide, Shift split step, V first person.

product.name: Product & Release
product.mission: Everything around the match: start flow, locker room, guide and versions. Each agent keeps its own part.
product.brief:
• main must always be playable (GitHub Pages deploys it).
• A version is published only when 5+ changes wait in contemporary/.
• Exit buttons only on side screens (locker room, help), never on the welcome page or during a match.
